python_thread_start.tooltip: Generate a named function, create a Thread for it, and start it immediately. Threads are not stopped automatically.

python_thread_join.message0: wait for thread or timer %1 timeout %2 seconds
python_thread_join.tooltip: Join a thread or timer. A blank timeout generates None and waits without a deadline.

python_thread_is_alive.tooltip: Return whether the named thread or timer is currently alive.

python_timer_start.message0: start timer %1 after %2 seconds daemon %3 do %4
python_timer_start.tooltip: Generate a named callback and start a one-shot Timer after the delay.

python_timer_cancel.tooltip: Cancel the timer only if its callback has not started yet.

python_lock_create.tooltip: Create a primitive non-reentrant Lock resource.

python_lock_acquire.tooltip: Acquire and return success. Plain wait ignores timeout; try once is non-blocking; timed wait uses the timeout input.

python_lock_release.tooltip: Release the lock. Python raises RuntimeError if it is already unlocked.

python_lock_locked.tooltip: Return a momentary snapshot of the lock state.

python_event_create.tooltip: Create an Event with its flag initially clear.

python_event_set.tooltip: Set the event flag and wake all current waiters.

python_event_clear.tooltip: Clear the event flag; later waiters block again.

python_event_wait.tooltip: Wait and return whether the event became set. A blank timeout waits without a deadline.

python_event_is_set.tooltip: Return a momentary snapshot of the event flag.

python_queue_create.tooltip: Create a thread-safe FIFO Queue. Maximum size 0 means unbounded.

python_queue_put.tooltip: Put an item. Plain wait ignores timeout; try once raises queue.Full if full; timed wait uses the timeout input.

python_queue_get.tooltip: Get and return an item. Plain wait ignores timeout; try once raises queue.Empty if empty; timed wait uses the timeout input.

python_queue_task_done.tooltip: Mark one previously retrieved item complete. Extra calls raise ValueError.

python_queue_join.message0: wait until queue %1 tasks are done
python_queue_join.tooltip: Wait without a timeout until task_done has matched every queued item.

python_queue_qsize.tooltip: Return an approximate size; another thread may change it immediately.

python_queue_empty.tooltip: Return an approximate empty snapshot; do not use it as a synchronization guarantee.
